Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement 2.3 Volume (6 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the learner sho
Topic 2.4: Capacity
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Capacity, part of Measurement 2.3 Volume (6 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the learner sho in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How are litres and millilitres used in day-to-day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Collect in purposive groups/pairs safe small containers and read the unit of measurements indicated in them. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to carry out the activity. Safety of all learners should be observed

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collect in purposive groups/pairs safe small containers and read the unit of measurements indicated in them. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to carry out the activity. Safety of all learners should be observed

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Capacity together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: as the learner shows responsibility as they share tasks with peers while filling small containers with water and

measure the capacity in millilitres using a container graduated in millilitres.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: as the learner enhancse social cohesion as they work with peers to estimate and measure capacity of different

containers using a container graduated in millilitres.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate concept of capacity to water conservation in Science and Technology.
